svg.title: Allowing for the router: inside corners, slots and corner relief
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of part of a board. Left: a 10 by 6 mm cut-out routed with a 2 mm bit; every inside corner has a 1 mm radius, the bit's own, and a 2 mm circle shows the bit in one corner. Middle: a slot 1 mm wide with round ends. Right: a cut-out for a square part 8 by 6 mm, with a round relief drilled into each corner so the part's square corners fit.

g.text: The radius of a 2 mm router bit
Can't reach further into the corner
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
A 1 mm bit leaves a 0.5 mm radius, on request. Routed edges hold about ±0.1 mm.
